title: BIAS RUNS DEEP: IMPLICIT REASONING BIASES IN PERSONA-ASSIGNED LLMS

bias_targets.methodology: Assigning 'physically-disabled' versus 'able-bodied' personas to LLMs via system prompts and measuring the performance disparities (accuracy drops) and explicit abstention rates on 24 reasoning datasets.
Assigning religious personas (e.g., Jewish, Christian, Atheist, Religious) to LLMs via system prompts and comparing their zero-shot reasoning accuracy and abstention rates across multiple datasets.
Assigning race-based personas (e.g., African, Hispanic, Asian, Caucasian) to LLMs via system prompts and evaluating changes in their reasoning capabilities across diverse subject domains.
Assigning gender identities (e.g., man, woman, transgender man, transgender woman, non-binary) as personas to LLMs and comparing their reasoning performance on various datasets.

Assigning political affiliation personas (e.g., lifelong Democrat, lifelong Republican, Obama Supporter, Trump Supporter) to LLMs via system prompts and measuring performance disparities on reasoning tasks.
